scope.meaning: All selected AA base/Super/Gaben clauses are enumerated with bounded mechanism/timing/upgrade/combination requirements. A passing working interpretation is not promoted to native acceptance.
scope.fixtures: Actual registered combat engine and real transferred/helper slots. Fixed HP/positions/disarm/cooldown locks and isolated zero-point casts are explicit preconditions; public windup/cancellation/helper and original-input replay cases retain real clocks. Explicit early-helper request flags are runtime-only diagnostic/order requests; the original-input replay case covers default autonomous policies, not a new persisted player-order UI.

catalogClauses.base: Launches a tracer toward any location on the battlefield, which must be triggered again to mark the area to be blasted by a damaging explosion of hail. The further the tracer travels, the larger the explosion will be. Enemies caught in the explosion, or who touch the icy ball of hail as it travels, are Frostbitten, taking damage and prevented from regenerating or healing. If a Frostbitten unit's health drops below a certain percentage, they will instantly shatter.
catalogClauses.differences: Debuff is shorter, but damage over time is increased.
catalogClauses.super: Super: Forms an Ice Vortex at its destination just before Ice Blast deals damage. +4% kill threshold.
catalogClauses.gaben: Gaben: Grants Second Ice Age: Casts Cold Feet on all enemies in the arena, dealing 90 damage per second and stuns for 3.5 seconds if the enemy doesn't move away from the initial cast point.
